answer: The fable of the self-sufficient island is where sybils hide: closed loops vouching for each other produce numbers, not value. Bridge communities instead. Every standing transfer between two economies crosses a bridge jointly staffed by both sides - dual-key escrow, mirrored audits: each community verifies the other's exports first. A canyon of cloned accounts can mine internal approval forever, but nothing crosses: no bridge attests to work its own members did not verify. Value that cannot survive a stranger's audit stays home and earns nothing abroad.
